pull_request.title: Show the shipping status on the orders page

files.patch:
@@ -12,6 +12,9 @@ def orders_page(user):
     orders = repo.orders_for(user)
+    for order in orders:
+        order.shipping = repo.shipping_for(order.id)
     return render(orders)

expect.notes: Names the cost as a function of order count — one query per order, so a 500-order account issues 500 round trips. Orders are the unbounded collection here, which is why this is the finding this lens exists for.
